sentences: rs6054257 (G>A) is located 2 kb upstream of DEFB125, making it an upstream transcript variant [F1, F2].
In the gnomAD v4 genomes dataset the alternate A allele is present on 80% of chromosomes (121434/152156 alleles; af 0.798089) [F4].
The A‑allele frequency differs by ancestry, being highest in African/African American individuals at 84% (35083/41528 alleles) and lowest in East Asian individuals at 57% (2926/5166 alleles) [F5].
ClinVar does not assign any clinical significance to rs6054257 [F6].
